mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a comfortable temperature of 74 degrees with overcast skies near Verona Area High School, under a waning crescent moon.

The Public Works Department is staying busy maintaining our city infrastructure, including streets and water utilities, and reminds everyone to check their latest archived newsletters online. Also, don't forget the Fire Department Open House is coming up on September 19 from 10 AM to 2 PM at the Lincoln Street station for tours and fire safety activities.

There is a lot happening today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, pizza and pitchers at Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, you can head over to Hop Haus Brewing for trivia night.

Regarding local safety, the Verona Police Department announced that on Sunday, August 30, they initiated an investigation into an inappropriate relationship between a former teacher and a student, which has led to an arrest.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and grab a treat.
